data.title: 五更琉璃 · 暖光书桌黑色蕾丝睡衣的执笔私密
data.description: 深夜五更家卧室内，琉璃身着半透明黑色蕾丝吊带娃娃装睡裙，蜷坐在转椅上握笔绘制同人本原稿，神情极度专注而又带着私密性感。
data.action: 单膝屈起踩在电脑转椅上，一手握数位笔在画板上描线，黑色蕾丝睡裙滑过白皙双膝，专注的神态别具动人风情
data.lighting: 桌面绘图台灯的聚光暖白光，电脑显示屏泛出微弱冷光
data.camera: 近景侧向机位，展现少女独处创作时的私密松弛状态
data.promptProse: Kuroneko works passionately late into the night at her cluttered wooden bedroom desk, preparing manuscript pages for an upcoming doujinshi convention. Dressed in a sheer black lace babydoll nightgown that slips gracefully over her raised knee, she grips a digital stylus, sketching intricate lines upon a glowing graphics tablet. The warm cone of light from her brass desk lamp casts a sanctuary of creative solitude.
data.animaCaption: A focused cone of desk lamp light illuminates Kuroneko's sketches as she draws intently in her sheer black lace nightgown.
